prompt:
A hand-painted 2D game background of the interior of a sturdy timber longhouse room, COMPLETELY EMPTY. Heavy dark-stained oak posts and cross-beams, walls of wide horizontal planks in warm mid-brown, a high ceiling with exposed rafters, and a floor of broad dark wooden boards. One tall shuttered window on the right-hand wall showing flat pale daylight and a distant sea horizon. Solid, warm, lived-in palette: walnut brown, amber, deep honey.

Soft gouache and watercolour painting with warm brown ink linework, visible brush texture, gentle washes rather than hard cel shading. Storybook illustration style, calm and warm, not photographic and not 3D rendered.

STRICT ONE-POINT PERSPECTIVE, and this is the most important instruction: a single central vanishing point on the horizontal centre line of the image. The BACK WALL is flat, rectangular and exactly parallel to the picture plane, filling the middle of the frame. The LEFT and RIGHT side walls converge inward toward that centre symmetrically, at equal and opposite angles. The floor runs away from the viewer straight toward the vanishing point. The camera is at standing eye level, looking level and straight ahead, dead centre, with no tilt, no roll and no rotation. The horizon sits at roughly 45 percent of the image height. Nothing is drawn at an angle to this grid.

THE ROOM MUST BE COMPLETELY BARE. There is NO fireplace, NO hearth, NO chimney breast, NO mantelpiece and NO fire anywhere in the image. There is no furniture of any kind: no table, no chairs, no bed, no chest, no shelves, no rug, no carpet, no barrels, no crates, no baskets. Nothing hangs on the walls: no pictures, no mounts, no trophies, no tools, no lamps, no candles. Nothing stands on the floor. The back wall is UNBROKEN from corner to corner. This is an empty shell that furniture will be painted on top of later, so every surface must be clear and unoccupied.

Even, soft, diffuse daylight with no dramatic shadows and no strong light source inside the room. No people, no animals, no text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no vignette, no frame.
